 .macro map map_id:req
# 5 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .ifdef \map_id
 .byte \map_id >> 8
 .byte \map_id & 0xFF
 .else
 .error "undefined map (check for typos)"
 .endif
 .endm


 .macro map_script type:req, script:req
# 15 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .byte \type
 .4byte \script
 .endm


 .macro map_script_2 var:req, compare:req, script:req
# 21 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .2byte \var
 .2byte \compare
 .4byte \script
 .endm


 .macro object_event index:req, gfx:req, x:req, y:req, elevation:req, movement_type:req, x_radius:req, y_radius:req, trainer_type:req, sight_radius_tree_etc:req, script:req, event_flag:req
# 28 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .byte \index
 .2byte \gfx
 .byte 0
 .2byte \x, \y
 .byte \elevation
 .byte \movement_type
 .if \x_radius > 15

  .error "movementRangeX has a bitfield of 4 bytes, so values over 15 will overflow. Use a custom script for item balls that should give the player more than 15 items."
 .endif
 .byte ((\y_radius << 4) | \x_radius)
 .space 1
 .2byte \trainer_type
 .2byte \sight_radius_tree_etc
 .4byte \script
 .2byte \event_flag
 .space 2
 inc _num_npcs
 .endm


 .macro clone_event index:req, gfx:req, x:req, y:req, target_local_id:req, target_map_id:req
# 50 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .byte \index
 .2byte \gfx
 .byte 255
 .2byte \x, \y
 .byte \target_local_id
 .space 3
 .2byte \target_map_id & 0xFF
 .2byte \target_map_id >> 8
 .space 8
 inc _num_npcs
 .endm


 .macro warp_def x:req, y:req, elevation:req, warpId:req, map_id:req
# 64 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .2byte \x, \y
 .byte \elevation
 .byte \warpId
 .byte \map_id & 0xFF
 .byte \map_id >> 8
 inc _num_warps
 .endm


 .macro coord_event x:req, y:req, elevation:req, var:req, varValue:req, script:req
# 74 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .2byte \x, \y
 .byte \elevation
 .space 1
 .2byte \var
 .2byte \varValue
 .space 2
 .4byte \script
 inc _num_traps
 .endm


 .macro coord_weather_event x:req, y:req, elevation:req, weather:req
# 86 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 coord_event \x, \y, \elevation, \weather, 0, NULL
 .endm




 .macro bg_event x:req, y:req, elevation:req, kind:req, arg6:req
# 93 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .2byte \x, \y
 .byte \elevation
 .byte \kind
 .space 2
 .4byte \arg6
 inc _num_signs
 .endm


 .macro bg_sign_event x:req, y:req, elevation:req, facing_dir:req, script:req
# 103 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 bg_event \x, \y, \elevation, \facing_dir, \script
 .endm


 .macro bg_hidden_item_event x:req, y:req, elevation:req, item:req, flag:req, quantity=1, underfoot=FALSE
# 108 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .if \flag < 0x1F4
 .error "Hidden Item flag \flag is too small. Must be >= FLAG_HIDDEN_ITEMS_START."
 .endif
 .if \item >= (1 << 12)
 .error "quantity \quantity too large"
 .endif
 .if \quantity >= (1 << 7)
 .error "quantity \quantity too large"
 .endif
 bg_event \x, \y, \elevation, BG_EVENT_HIDDEN_ITEM, \item | (((\flag) - 0x1F4) << 11)| (\quantity << 24) | (\underfoot << 31)
 .endm


 .macro bg_secret_base_event x:req, y:req, elevation:req, secret_base_id:req
# 122 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 bg_event \x, \y, \elevation, BG_EVENT_SECRET_BASE, \secret_base_id
 .endm


 .macro map_events npcs:req, warps:req, traps:req, signs:req
# 127 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .byte _num_npcs, _num_warps, _num_traps, _num_signs
 .4byte \npcs, \warps, \traps, \signs
 reset_map_events
 .endm


 .macro reset_map_events
# 134 "asm/macros/map.inc"
 .set _num_npcs, 0
 .set _num_warps, 0
 .set _num_traps, 0
 .set _num_signs, 0
 .endm


 reset_map_events

 .endm

 .set ALLOCATE_SPECIAL_TABLE, 0
# 1 "data/specials.inc"
.macro def_special, ptr:req, waitstate=0, requests_effects=0
# 2 "data/specials.inc"
.if ALLOCATE_SPECIAL_TABLE
  .global SPECIAL_\ptr
  .set SPECIAL_\ptr, __special__
  .if \requests_effects == 0
    .4byte \ptr
  .else
    .4byte \ptr + ROM_SIZE
  .endif
.endif
.set SPECIAL_WAITSTATE_\ptr, \waitstate
.set __special__, __special__ + 1
.endm

.set __special__, 0
.if ALLOCATE_SPECIAL_TABLE
  .align 2
.global gSpecials
gSpecials:
.endif

 .macro formatwarp map:req, a, b, c
# 447 "asm/macros/event.inc"
 map \map
 .ifb \a
  .byte (-1)
  .2byte -1
  .2byte -1
 .else
 .ifb \b
  .byte \a
  .2byte -1
  .2byte -1
 .else
 .ifb \c
  .byte (-1)
  .2byte \a
  .2byte \b
 .else
  .byte \a
  .2byte \b
  .2byte \c
 .endif
 .endif
 .endif
 .endm

 .macro trainerbattle type:req localIdA:req, trainer_a:req, intro_text_a:req, lose_text_a:req, event_script_a:req, localIdB:req, trainer_b:req, intro_text_b:req, lose_text_b:req, event_script_b:req, victory_text:req, cannot_battle:req, isDouble:req, playMusicA:req, playMusicB:req, isRematch:req, rival_battle_flags=0
# 757 "asm/macros/event.inc"
 .byte SCR_OP_TRAINERBATTLE
 .set trainerbattle_flags, 0
 .ifgt \isDouble; .set trainerbattle_flags, trainerbattle_flags | (1 << 0); .endif
 .ifgt \isRematch; .set trainerbattle_flags, trainerbattle_flags | (1 << 1); .endif
 .ifgt \playMusicA; .set trainerbattle_flags, trainerbattle_flags | (1 << 2); .endif
 .ifgt \playMusicB; .set trainerBattle_flags, trainerbattle_flags | (1 << 3); .endif
 .ifgt \type; .set trainerbattle_flags, trainerbattle_flags | (\type << 4); .endif
 .byte trainerbattle_flags
 .byte \localIdA
 .2byte \trainer_a
 .4byte \intro_text_a
 .4byte \lose_text_a
 .4byte \event_script_a
 .byte \localIdB
 .2byte \trainer_b
 .4byte \intro_text_b
 .4byte \lose_text_b

 .4byte \cannot_battle

 .endm

 .macro randomelement element:req, elements:vararg
# 2291 "asm/macros/event.inc"
 .set _randomelement_n, 0
 .irp el, \element, \elements
 .set _randomelement_n, _randomelement_n + 1
 .endr
  random _randomelement_n

 .set _randomelement_n, 0
 .irp el, \element, \elements
  goto_if_ne 0x800D, _randomelement_n, 1f
  setorcopyvar 0x800D, \el
  goto 2f
 1:
 .set _randomelement_n, _randomelement_n + 1
 .endr
 2:
 .endm



 .macro randompercentage percent:req
# 2311 "asm/macros/event.inc"
  random 100
  goto_if_lt 0x800D, \percent, 1f
  setvar 0x800D, FALSE
  goto 2f
 1:
  setvar 0x800D, TRUE
 2:
 .endm

 .macro move_tutor moveId:req, wantTeachingMsg:req, monSelectMsg:req, declinedJmp:req, taughtJmp:req, flagId=0

  goto_if_set \flagId, \taughtJmp

  call MoveTutor_EventScript_CanOnlyBeLearnedOnce

 .endm

 .macro setfollowernpc localId:req, flags:req, script=0, battlePartner=0
# 2720 "asm/macros/event.inc"
 .if FALSE
  checkfollowernpc
  compare 0x800D, FALSE
  goto_if_ne 1f
  hidefollower
  waitmovement 0xFE
  callnative ScriptSetFollowerNPC
  .if \script == 0
   .set setScript, FALSE
  .else
   .set setScript, TRUE
  .endif
  .byte \localId
  .2byte \flags
  .byte setScript
  .2byte \battlePartner
  .4byte \script
  updatefollowingmon
  1:
 .else
  .error "setfollowernpc unavailable with FNPC_ENABLE_NPC_FOLLOWERS defined as FALSE"
 .endif
 .endm

 lock
 faceplayer
 msgbox MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThisIsMauvilleGameCorner, MSGBOX_DEFAULT

 goto_if_eq 0x800D, FALSE, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_NeedCoinCase

.ifdef MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_CoinsClerk ; .size MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_CoinsClerk, . - MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_CoinsClerk ; .endif ; .global MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_ChooseCoinsDefault50

 switch 0x800D
 case 0, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_Buy50Coins
 case 1, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_Buy500Coins
 goto MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_CancelBuyCoins
 end


.ifdef MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_ChooseCoinsDefault50 ; .size MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_ChooseCoinsDefault50, . - MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_ChooseCoinsDefault50 ; .endif ; .global MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_ChooseCoinsDefault500

 goto_if_ge (0x4000 + 0x1), (9999 + 1 - 50), MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_NoRoomForCoins

 goto_if_eq 0x800D, FALSE, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_NotEnoughMoney

 updatecoinsbox 1, 6

 hidemoneybox
 hidecoinsbox 0, 5

 end

.ifdef JaggedPass_OnResume ; .size JaggedPass_OnResume, . - JaggedPass_OnResume ; .endif ; .global JaggedPass_EventScript_CheckHasMagmaEmblem

.ifdef JaggedPass_EventScript_CheckHasMagmaEmblem ; .size JaggedPass_EventScript_CheckHasMagmaEmblem, . - JaggedPass_EventScript_CheckHasMagmaEmblem ; .endif ; .global JaggedPass_EventScript_SetReadyToOpenHideout

# 1692 "data/event_scripts.s"
# 1 "data/scripts/contest_hall.inc"

.global LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_SpeakToContestReceptionist
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_SpeakToContestReceptionist:
 lock
 faceplayer
 goto_if_ne 0x408A, 0, LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_PickUpPrize
 call_if_set 0x5F, LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_ReceptionWelcome
 call_if_unset 0x5F, LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GivePokeblockCase
 goto LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_AskEnterContest
 end

.ifdef LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_SpeakToContestReceptionist ; .size LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_SpeakToContestReceptionist, . - LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_SpeakToContestReceptionist ; .endif ; .global LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_ReceptionWelcome
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_ReceptionWelcome:
 msgbox LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestReception, MSGBOX_DEFAULT
 return

.ifdef LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_ReceptionWelcome ; .size LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_ReceptionWelcome, . - LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_ReceptionWelcome ; .endif ; .global LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GivePokeblockCase
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GivePokeblockCase:
 msgbox LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceptionDontHavePokeblockCase, MSGBOX_DEFAULT
 giveitem ITEM_POKEBLOCK_CASE
 goto_if_eq 0x800D, FALSE, Common_EventScript_ShowBagIsFull
 setflag 0x5F
 msgbox LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NowThatWeveClearedThatUp, MSGBOX_DEFAULT
 return

.ifdef LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GivePokeblockCase ; .size LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GivePokeblockCase, . - LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GivePokeblockCase ; .endif ; .global LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_PickUpPrize
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_PickUpPrize:
 msgbox LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PokemonWonWeHavePrize, MSGBOX_DEFAULT
 switch 0x408A
 case 4, LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GiveLuxuryBallAtCounter
 end

.ifdef LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_PickUpPrize ; .size LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_PickUpPrize, . - LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_PickUpPrize ; .endif ; .global LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GiveLuxuryBallAtCounter
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GiveLuxuryBallAtCounter:
 giveitem ITEM_LUXURY_BALL
 goto_if_eq 0x800D, FALSE, LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_NoRoomForLuxuryBallAtCounter
 setvar 0x408A, 0
 closemessage
 release
 end

.ifdef LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GiveLuxuryBallAtCounter ; .size LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GiveLuxuryBallAtCounter, . - LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_GiveLuxuryBallAtCounter ; .endif ; .global LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_NoRoomForLuxuryBallAtCounter
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_EventScript_NoRoomForLuxuryBallAtCounter:
 call Common_EventScript_BagIsFull
 msgbox LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ComeBackForPrizeLater, MSGBOX_DEFAULT
 release

.endif

.if 0 != 0
 showberrydescription
.endif

 waitmessage

 waitbuttonpress
 message ApricornTree_Text_PutAwayApricorn
 waitmessage
 waitbuttonpress
.if 0 != 0

.endif

 end
